_why: The three delivered programs the reviewing coach scored in Phase 1, mapped to the committed fixtures that hold them. Derived once by matching audit signatures and opening lines after the scratchpad copies were lost in a container rebuild; recorded here so it never has to be derived again. Dimension scores are the coach's, and reproduce his overall score through engine/coach_standard.js. Football A/B/C were scored after the in-season dimension set was defined; its weights reproduce all three, as the first three types did.

programs.identified_by: TAPER AUDIT W1-W3 all 69 sets at 39% competition share; contains the unsupported '4 kg cut' claim; peak intensity 82/84/87% never reaching the 89-90% band

findings.what: Snatch Pull 130 kg x 3 is a named maintenance benchmark with no direct pulling exposure anywhere
intensity never reaches the 89-90% intensification band
five consecutive training days despite flexible availability
accessory redundancy: four rowing exposures
contingency creates an adjacent duplicate squat
audit reports 69 sets in Weeks 1 and 2 while the text says volume comes down
asserts a 'routine 4 kg cut' with no support in the intake

three consecutive lower-body days (Sat ruck, Sun lunge + run, Mon squat + run)
weighted pull-up fixed at +22.5 kg 3x4 for four weeks against a demonstrated +30 kg x 5
days_per_week: 3 against five calendar training days, interpretation never stated
